concept.subject: A tall market house whose stacked balconies are shaded by striped awnings slanting alternately in and out, with flower pots and lanterns along the rails.
concept.composition: The facade fills the middle three fifths of the width from a quarter of the height to the bottom, its flat roof below the open top center. On each side four awnings stack in a zigzag: toward the middle, outward, toward the middle, outward; the two sides are mirror images. Narrow stair towers stand at the far left and right edges and end above the lower corners.
concept.layout: 53 round pegs and 94 bricks. Every awning is a straight brick slide of four to six bricks, mirrored on the two sides and stacked so a ball zigzags from awning to awning down the facade; the stair towers' roofs are short brick slopes. The balcony rails under the awnings are short peg rows, and the flower pots and lanterns are single pegs.

difficulty.note: Brick-heavy finale: the zigzag slides carry balls far, but the rails under the awnings stay shielded until the ball finds the gaps.

background.prompt: A tall market house at golden hour seen from the front, its facade filling the middle three fifths of the picture width from about one quarter of the picture height down to the bottom, with open sky above its flat roof at the top center. On each side of the facade, four striped awnings in cream and muted dusty-rose stripes shade four stacked balconies: the top awning slants down toward the middle, the next one outward, the third toward the middle again and the lowest outward, so that they form a zigzag down each side, the left and right sides mirror images of each other. Each awning is about a seventh of the picture wide. Small potted plants and paper lanterns stand along the balcony rails under the awnings. Honey and cream stone walls with slate-blue shutters; two narrow stair towers stand at the far left and right edges; the lower corners are plain stone.
